name: GE Appliances
legalEntityNote: Haier US Appliance Solutions, Inc. does business as GE Appliances and is owned through Haier Smart Home within Haier Group. The company continues to use the GE Appliances name under a long-term trademark license; ownership of the operating company and ownership of the GE trademark are therefore separate facts.

ownership.summary: GE Appliances is operated by Haier US Appliance Solutions, Inc., a Haier Smart Home-owned company within Haier Group. Haier completed the appliance-business acquisition in 2016, while the GE Appliances name continues under a long-term trademark license. GE Appliances' operating company, Haier ownership, the GE trademark, its portfolio brands and individual factories therefore represent related but distinct identity layers.
ownership.parentCompany: Haier Smart Home Co., Ltd., within Haier Group

productPortfolio.name: Cooking and refrigeration
productPortfolio.positioning: GE Appliances serves U.S. households across GE, GE Profile, Café and Monogram product tiers.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Brand tier, dimensions, fuel type, connectivity, installation and service terms need exact-model comparison.

productPortfolio.name: Laundry and dishwashing
productPortfolio.positioning: Washers, dryers and dishwashers are supported by category-specific U.S. manufacturing and service operations.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Do not convert company-level U.S. investment claims into model origin without factory and label evidence.

productPortfolio.name: Water, air and small appliances
productPortfolio.positioning: Selected market ranges extend into water treatment, room air products, disposers and countertop appliances.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Categories can use different factories, suppliers, channels and warranty structures from major appliances.

productPortfolio.name: Multi-brand U.S. portfolio
productPortfolio.positioning: The operating company presents Monogram, Café, GE Profile, GE, Haier and U.S.-market Hotpoint as distinct brands or ranges.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Authorization and trademark rights must be verified for the named brand and category, not inferred from the parent company.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: GE Appliances reports U.S. manufacturing operations across five states, including Appliance Park in Louisville and other product-specialized sites.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Match the exact product and model to a named facility, rating label and country-of-origin record.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: GE Appliances' operations page assigns distinct manufacturing and business functions to named U.S. locations.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Verify whether the facility makes the covered finished product, a component or a different product family.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The operating legal entity is Haier US Appliance Solutions, Inc. doing business as GE Appliances.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Corporate identity, not automatic model-manufacturer proof
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Compare the contract, compliance label, customs record and warranty to identify each responsible entity.

marketsChannels.evidence: GE Appliances uses direct websites, national retailers, dealers, builders, distributors and authorized service channels in the United States.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm dealer authorization, project-channel restrictions, installation scope and local service coverage.

marketsChannels.evidence: GE Appliances, GE Profile, Café, Monogram, Haier and Hotpoint occupy distinct positions within the U.S. portfolio.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Secure rights for the specific brand and product class rather than relying on a general GE Appliances relationship.

marketsChannels.evidence: Warranty and service obligations are defined in product-specific GE Appliances documents and can name the operating or service entity.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Retain the exact warranty, model serial information and authorized-servicer terms for the sale.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: GE Appliances combines a familiar U.S. market identity, a tiered brand portfolio, substantial domestic manufacturing operations and Haier Smart Home backing. Its defining diligence issue is the licensed-name structure: buyers must keep the GE trademark, the Haier-owned operating company, portfolio brands and model-level manufacturing evidence separate.
